contract_grounding.note: No structured_contract.json file exists for qdrant 1.18.0 - evaluating based on API semantic contract and source code evidence

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: check_vector_against_config exists at lib/segment/src/common/mod.rs:188 but is NOT called in the WAL async path (wait=false). Validation only occurs in WaitUntil::Visible path (wait=true). API layer (lib/api/src/rest/validate.rs) has no dimension check.
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: lib/segment/src/common/mod.rs:188-219 定义了 check_vector_against_config 函数检查向量维度,但在 WAL 异步路径(wait=false)中未调用此校验。仅在 WaitUntil::Visible 路径(wait=true)执行维度校验。REST API 层(lib/api/src/rest/validate.rs)无维度校验。这导致异步插入错误维度向量时返回 HTTP 200 'acknowledged' 但点未实际持久化。

cognition_match.developer_quote: Parameter validation on filter/condition APIs (min_should, value_count)
cognition_match.note: 缺陷命中开发者认知盲点: 参数验证在异步路径缺失。虽然 developer_cognition.json 提到了参数验证盲点,但本案例是向量维度验证(而非 filter 参数),属于同一类验证缺失问题。开发者优先考虑'数据一致性'胜过 API 严格性,但此处异步路径的无验证返回误导性成功响应违反数据一致性原则。

contract.explicit_requirement: API should validate vector dimensions match collection config for all insert operations (implicit API contract)

physical.objective_constraint: Vector dimension is objective constraint: collection configured for dimension 4, vector must have exactly 4 elements
physical.note: 物理约束明确违反: 集合配置维度=4,提供向量维度=3,API 接受此违反值(返回 HTTP 200)违反物理约束。

behavioral.note: 行为不优雅: 返回 HTTP 200 'acknowledged' 但点未实际持久化,这是误导性的成功响应。源码中无显式 by-design 注释表明这是有意设计。

perspective_analysis.aggregation_applied: verdict_B=CONFIRMED (physical violation) + verdict_C=CONFIRMED (misleading success response) → final=CONFIRMED

verdicts.rationale: 经干净复现与源码接地确认: PUT /points 在 wait=false 异步模式下接受错误维度向量(3元素 vs 集合配置4元素)并返回 HTTP 200 'acknowledged',但点未实际持久化(GET 返回 404)。源码显示 check_vector_against_config 函数存在但仅在 WaitUntil::Visible 同步路径调用,WAL 异步路径绕过维度校验。这是验证不一致性缺陷,非平凡解释。
